column1: # Original all-round navigation choices, reviewed 2026-10-24. Key: slot/kind/band/rank/baseTicks/hands/group.
# Weapons compare band before kind; armour/offhands keep kind before band. Bands are layout policy, not DPS.
# Mature one-handers (30+) retain the owner's general weapon+defender preference; advanced two-handers (24) precede earlier one-handers (10-22).
# Facts: Wiki weapon/item pages and cached canonical identities; July buffs: Update:Summer_Sweep-Up_Gear_%26_PvM_Changes.
# Advanced two-handed fallbacks remain behind mature one-handers, but precede early/midgame one-handers.
# Their ranks do not apply target/set/spec effects or compare raw Strength across different mechanics.
# Avernic/Dragon defenders receive an explicit all-round accuracy preference over DFS. Lower defenders do not.
# Failed Emir's Arena ornament rewards 26708/26710 are not live-bank candidates.
